Here’s everything you need to know before Sunday.

Sundays

9:00 AM & 11:00 AM

Century City Conference Centre, Cape Town

What to Expect

Simple. Warm. Meaningful.

01

Arrive & Connect

Doors open 30 min before. Grab a coffee, find a seat, no pressure.

Worship, a practical talk from the Bible, and prayer. About 75 minutes.

For Families

Kids are welcome.

We run age-appropriate programmes for children aged 0–11 during both services. Check-in at the welcome desk when you arrive — we’ll take care of the rest.

Kids

FAQ

Questions? We’ve got answers.

What should I wear? +

Whatever you’re comfortable in. Jeans, shorts, or your Sunday best — all are welcome.

Is there parking? +

Yes, we have free on-site parking available.

What about my kids? +

We run programmes for ages 0–11 during both services. Check in at the welcome desk and we’ll get them settled.

I don’t know the songs? +

We display lyrics on screen. Just listen if you prefer — no pressure to sing along.

Do I need to bring anything? +

Nothing except yourself. We’ll provide everything you need.

Can I just watch online? +

Yes — services are streamed on YouTube. But we’d love to see you in person whenever you’re ready.

We’re looking forward to meeting you
